title: Dynamic Add-on Orchestration: Retention Offers + Automated Security Questionnaire Pilot
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Run a controlled pilot that offers dynamic observability retention tiers (30d / 90d / 365d) as paid add-ons and pairs those offers with an automated enterprise security questionnaire flow during contract negotiation. The goal is to test price elasticity for retention, reduce manual security review time by 50%, and measure conversion uplift for premium SLA bundles when observability retention is presented as a coordinate add-on.

Context: Sales and CSM teams report frequent ad hoc discounts and long-cycle manual security questionnaire handoffs for enterprise deals that request longer log retention or tighter SLAs. We want a productized offering that: 1) is surfaced during checkout and sales quoting, 2) can be gated behind feature flags, 3) ties to entitlement logic, and 4) creates an auditable contract artifact that legal can sign off on.

Primary outcomes/OKRs: 
- Revenue signal: incremental ARR from retention add-on offers during pilot (> $75k ARR target).
- Operational signal: reduce manual security questionnaire turnaround time from 8 days to <=4 days for pilot accounts.
- Product signal: measured conversion lift of premium SLA when retention add-on is accepted (target +8% conversion).

Experiment design:
- Cohorts: A (control) receives standard bundle UI; B (experiment) sees dynamic retention pricing tiers + automated questionnaire trigger in the quote flow.
- Pricing matrix: three retention tiers with fixed monthly add-on prices (30d: $0, 90d: $X, 365d: $Y) — amounts to be validated with finance.
- Rollout: gated behind feature flag per org; initial pilot with 8 sales-led enterprise prospects over 6 weeks.

Success criteria (pass/fail):
- Positive revenue signal (>= target) OR clear behavioral improvement that is demonstrably scalable.
- Questionnaire automation reduces manual steps by at least 30% and time to completion <=4 days for pilot accounts.
- No critical security/legal objections to the automated artifact format.

Out of scope: global pricing change, changes to token billing model, or automated entitlement enforcement beyond pilot accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Feature flag allows enabling add-on UI per org
Retention tiers visible in quote and checkout flows
Automated security questionnaire pre-populates with org metadata and produces a signed artifact stored in contract storage
Dashboard shows per-org retention choice, revenue recognized, and questionnaire status
Pilot telemetry published: conversion rate, q turnaround time, and discounting incidents

notes_for_csm_and_sales: When discussing retention tiers with customers, frame as data retention for enhanced troubleshooting + longer traceability for regulatory audits.
If customer requests custom retention outside tiers, capture as feedback but avoid custom discounts during pilot; escalate to PM for review.
Use the questionnaire to capture SOC2/ISO-specific answers — aim to have Legal pre-approve common responses to accelerate turnaround.
